THE HOLLOWBROOK ASYLUM

1987. You are a night-shift orderly who woke up locked inside the East Wing. The building has been abandoned for a decade — except it isn't empty. Something else walks these halls now, drawn to light and sound. You are not sure how many of them there are.

Find the 3 brass keys hidden in the wards, unlock the Exit Door, and get out alive. Read any notes you find — they'll tell you what happened here.
